title: runway-spotcheck-integration-huddle-2028-07-31
summary: Weekly sync notes for RoadRunway onramp + cross-team handoff items. Focus: unblock network/SAML, verify perf regression, finalize canary config for dedicated pool.
body:
Attendees: Ava Martinez (SE lead), Daniel Cho (Field Eng), Priya Nair (Solutions PM), Marcus Li (Infra), Sofia Reynolds (Customer Success)

Quick purpose: short, actionable spot-check on Runway onboarding status. Hybrid meeting — 30m. Capture immediate blockers, owners, next steps for pairing with infra and SRE.

High-level status (green/yellow/red):
- Runway: YELLOW — integration largely functional but two customer-facing regressions + security gating remain.
- Internal handoff readiness: YELLOW — docs mostly drafted, need final network diagrams & SAML mapping verified.

Customer-specific notes:
1) Runway (pilot):
   - Current behavior: chat generation working; occasional 500s during long-context (>3k tokens) sessions.
   - Suspected cause: KV cache eviction pattern combined with gRPC keepalive timeouts in the customer's NAT gateway.
   - Recent attempt: increased KV cache size on canary nodepool (temp) — reduced errors by ~30% in internal smoke tests.
   - Blocker: Runway security team needs confirmation that outbound egress IPs are pinned (they're on a restricted allowlist). Marcus to provide final egress IP list.
   - Action items:
     * Marcus Li -> produce egress IPs + CIDR list and post to Slack (due 2028-08-02)
     * Daniel Cho -> schedule coordinated NAT timeout test with customer (due 2028-08-04)

2) BlueCove (embedding/rerank pilot):
   - Status: GREEN for embeddings, YELLOW for rerank latency.
   - Details: rerank requests intermittently spike when batch size increases; looks like suboptimal batching policy for their traffic shape.
   - Notes: Priya validated that the model variant used is q4f16; engineering to recommend q2a quantized variant to trade slight quality for p50 latency gain.
   - Action items:
     * Ava Martinez -> write short A/B plan for quantized variant (due 2028-08-03)
     * Infra -> run 24h perf harness comparing q4f16 vs q2a on 2x A100 (due 2028-08-06)

3) TigerBridge (dedicated deployment):
   - Status: RED -> deployment stuck on preflight because of SAML attribute mapping mismatch.
   - Root cause: IdP sends group claim as 'groups' array; our SAML mapping previously used 'memberOf' string. Existing mapping flow failed silently.
   - Temporary workaround: manual account creation and RBAC assignment in console (not scalable).
   - Action items:
     * Priya Nair + Sofia Reynolds -> collect IdP example assertion and create mapping doc (due 2028-08-01)
     * Dev (SAML team) -> implement flexible attr-name fallback in SAML processor (ticket RED-4081) (due 2028-08-07)

Cross-cutting technical issues:
- Perf regression when sequence length > 4k tokens on the hosted canary (noticed 2028-07-29 after runtime bump):
  * Repro steps: run retrace-perf.sh from infra/harness with seq=4096, batch=4.  p95 latency increased ~40% vs baseline.
  * Hypothesis: new fused-attention kernel selection regressed for certain layer patterns in the new model shim. Also possible suboptimal CUDA workspace sizes.
  * Immediate next step: Marcus to roll a runtime canary pinned to previous kernel selection to compare (quick rollback test) (due 2028-07-31 EOD).
  * If rollback improves, open PR to restore previous kernel selection with more detailed kernel benchmarks.

- Canary routing and automatic fallback config:
  * Current canary traffic vector uses percent by route; need to ensure canary fallback hits q2a model variants when q4f16 is unhealthy.
  * Action: Ava + Marcus to propose fallback policy change and test in staging (proposal due 2028-08-05).

Operational/Docs:
- Onboarding checklist missing: final network diagram, SSO mapping example, token provisioning steps for customer engineers. PR link created but needs review.
  * Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/934
  * Action: Daniel to review onboarding doc and add NAT/egress section (due 2028-08-02)

Customer success & communication:
- Messaging plan for Runway customers about the 4k regression: keep it light — "we're investigating performance on long-context sessions and will apply a targeted canary roll to mitigate". Sofia to draft message (due 2028-08-01).

Risks & mitigation:
- Risk: If SAML attr mapping fix slips, TigerBridge go-live delayed -> escalates to CSM/AE. Mitigation: manual RBAC and temporary admin creds (short-term), parallel effort on attribute fallback logic.
- Risk: egress IP changes after infra scaling — could break allowlist for customers. Mitigation: publish an egress IP versioning policy and ensure infra automation pins predictable ranges.

Decisions made in this huddle:
- Prioritize SAML attr flexible handling over immediate model variant swaps for TigerBridge go-live.
- Run two parallel experiments for the 4k performance issue: (1) runtime kernel rollback, (2) quantized model variant A/B for latency.

Open questions / fast follow:
- Is there telemetry that correlates KV cache evictions to the 500s? (Marcus to check cache metrics and post sample timeline) (due 2028-08-03)
- If rollback fixes perf, what's the risk to other customers? (Ava to coordinate a cross-customer smoke run prior to rollback PR merge) (due 2028-08-06)

Action item tracker (short):
- Marcus Li: egress IP list + runtime canary rollback test (due 2028-07-31/2028-08-02)
- Daniel Cho: NAT timeout test scheduling + onboarding doc review (due 2028-08-04/2028-08-02)
- Priya Nair: collect IdP assertion + SAML mapping doc (due 2028-08-01)
- Ava Martinez: A/B plan for q2a variant + coordinate smoke run (due 2028-08-03/2028-08-06)
- Sofia Reynolds: customer comms draft (due 2028-08-01)

Notes to self / informal:
- Keep pull requests small and labeled 'onramp-runway' so SE can track.
- Consider adding a small script to the onboarding repo that validates SAML attr names against common IdPs (good ROI).
- Follow up: set 15m micro-standup on Mon for the next two weeks to close blockers faster.

Next sync: Tentatively Tue 2028-08-07 10:00 PT (short 20m) — focus: verify SAML mapping + perf harness results.

Meeting raw capture: had some side-channel convo in Slack about BlueCove batching — Daniel will post perf traces. Also flagged that the customer's TLS terminator returns http1.1 which causes some gRPC fallback churn; Marcus to check if we should explicit enforce http2 with ALPN in our LB (low pri unless we see repeat failures).
